# 0.0.2-dev.1: ???? (??-??-????)

## Breaking changes

- embedio now requires Quarto 1.10 or later.

## Features

- `html`: Include an HTML file inside of an iframe ([#6](https://github.com/coatless-quarto/embedio/pull/6))
- `html` and `revealjs`: Specify width for the iframe ([#13](https://github.com/coatless-quarto/embedio/pull/13))

## Bug fixes

- `audio`, `pdf`, `revealjs`, and `html` copy the embedded file to the output directory automatically, so it no longer needs to be listed under `resources`. ([#16](https://github.com/coatless-quarto/embedio/pull/16))
- `audio`, `pdf`, `revealjs`, and `html` stop the render with an error that names the shortcode when no file is given. Previously, `pdf`, `revealjs`, and `html` silently embedded an empty frame, and `audio` failed with "assertion failed!".
- embedio escapes file paths, sizes, and classes in the HTML it writes. Previously, a file name with a double quote broke the embed, and some non-ASCII file names were garbled.
- `audio` adds a `<figcaption>` and a `class` only when `caption` and `class` are set, and no longer writes an invalid `type` attribute on `<audio>`. Audio files and URLs without a file extension now work; previously they stopped the render.
- `audio`, `pdf`, `revealjs`, and `html` produce no output in non-HTML formats such as PDF, Typst, Word and Markdown. Previously, any document that used them failed to render to those formats with "Cannot get Attr from TypeNil".

## Changes

- Refactored `revealjs` to use a general `iframe_helper`. ([#6](https://github.com/coatless-quarto/embedio/pull/6))
- Added `make help` target to the Makefile and improved recipes. ([#7](https://github.com/coatless-quarto/embedio/pull/7))

## Documentation

- Added `html` documentation page to index. ([#8](https://github.com/coatless-quarto/embedio/pull/8))
- Cleaned up documentation for existing shortcodes. ([#8](https://github.com/coatless-quarto/embedio/pull/8))
- The `pdf` page lists the correct default `height`, `600px`. Previously it said `850px`.

# 0.0.1: If It Fits, I Sits (04-22-2024)

## Features

- `embedio` shortcode options to add different pieces of content to Quarto HTML websites, documents, and books.
  - `pdf`: Include a PDF file
  - `revealjs`: Include RevealJS slides
  - `audio`: Include an Audio file
